title: Notion Shell — page/sidebar/database wrapper primitives + slash menu + decorator
description: Portable Notion-style wrapper primitives: NotionPage (header + body shell), NotionHeader (icon + title), NotionSidebar (tree nav with full page CRUD), NotionBlock (single-block renderer dispatching via prop registry, live inline-markdown decorator, hover actions menu), NotionDatabase (table view + per-cell CRUD), NotionProperty (value + schema editor), SlashMenu (searchable block-type picker with keyboard nav), BlockActionsMenu (turn-into / duplicate / delete popover), InsertBlockButton ("+" trigger w/ SlashMenu popover). Pure / props-driven — host owns data + change handlers. Drop into any React surface; pair with notion-blocks for the four editor primitives (equation, code, notify, grid). Lifted from notion-page-clone's shared/components/notion + editor slice.
